file(GLOB osk_rc_deps res/*.*)
add_rc_deps(osk.rc ${osk_rc_deps})

# osk.exe is all Rust (osk-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/osk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# keyboard.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/osk-rust/src/osk/keyboard/mod.rs, generated: port data)
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/osk-rust/src/osk/main.rs)
# settings.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/osk-rust/src/osk/settings.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(osk_res OBJECT osk.rc)
target_compile_definitions(osk_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(osk_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(OSK_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(osk osk-cargo osk.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE osk-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS osk_res ${OSK_REUSED})
